search_window.basis: Prior confirmed ops/watch-ledger Food Line heartbeat completion to present observation. Only event/source publication timestamps after the prior check qualify as new; indexing timestamps do not.

coverage_notes.purpose: Supplementary high-value miss-class recall; primary nationwide Food Line production collection remains authoritative.
target_classes: Closure/fire/disaster affecting the only, sole, last, or full-service grocery store in a community
Emergency food distributions canceled or suspended because of storm, flood, fire, outage, or facility damage
Abrupt pantry/food-bank closure or major access reduction
Official SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruption with immediate access consequences
bounded_query_context: "Nov 1 2026" emergency food distribution cancelled storm flooding
"November 1 2026" food pantry distribution canceled power outage
coverage_notes.observation: No new source-published qualifying U.S. food-access disruption verifiable after the prior 21:44:41 PST check. Search results were dominated by older grocery closures, routine mobile pantry scheduling, old SNAP/EBT guidance, generic weather advisories, and unconnected outages. No official immediate benefits interruption, emergency distribution cancellation, or verified sole-store loss newly surfaced.

duplicate_screen.method: Read prior GitHub watch ledger heartbeat and checked previously surfaced Provo/other older events for duplicates.

coverage_notes.limitations: Twelve search queries returned indexed results but precision was poor, especially on official SNAP/WIC terms. This bounded recall is not comprehensive and does not establish absence of unindexed local updates.
coverage_notes.production_authority: No approvals, publication, primary-collector changes, schedule changes, or task disabling.
